capabilities: Parse Claude Code JSONL session files into turns
Render tool calls with per-tool layouts
Search across all sessions or within one
Export sessions to Markdown or self-contained HTML
Distill session stats into queryable notes
disambiguation: Not a Claude chat client or Claude Code runner; it only reads and displays existing session files from disk.
extras: Desktop only. Rate-limit display is beta and off by default; the community scanner flags its Keychain/shell usage. Warns that Claude Code deletes session files older than 30 days. Exposes a stable public API for other plugins.
problem: Claude Code stores sessions as JSONL files outside Obsidian, so browsing, searching, or exporting them next to notes is not possible.

relations.evidence: The plugin reads Claude Code's JSONL files straight from disk.
This needs the Bases core plugin enabled
build up notes from your Claude work with Bases or Dataview

summary: Parser and viewer that reads Claude Code JSONL session logs from disk and renders them as searchable, exportable timelines inside Obsidian.
